readerSummary: The recurring method is reconstructable: attend to relationships and recurring friction, give them an explicit model, make an interface people can use, inspect use and correction with others, then preserve ownership and working context. Three linked operational examples support this sequence; WOWList, CallNYC, and the research lab add bounded technical continuities.
